heroGrammar: Dark command-center hero with left oversized treasury headline, compact action pills, right floating intelligence console, and metric cards nested inside a financial glow field.
gridSystem: Wide 1440 source frame with dark full-width bands, fixed editorial gutters, horizontal proof rows, console slots, and three-column enterprise card grids.
layoutGesture: Operating-system narrative: buyer scans risk signal, sees dashboard proof, then moves through controls, compliance, pricing, proof, and demo closure.
sectionSilhouettes: large dashboard placeholder plus copy rail
left proof copy plus right checklist
glowing CTA panel and dense footer map
compositionTension: High contrast finance darkness, tight enterprise scan rows, luminous data accents, and asymmetric console placement create urgency without copying either reference.
focalPath: Headline to console metrics to proof strip to workflow rows to pricing/demo conversion.
negativeSpaceShape: Dark runway spaces and horizontal audit bands give finance content breathing room while preserving dense buyer proof.
depthLayering: Console elevation, data-signal glow, raised pricing card, and semantic shadow tokens separate live product proof from copy sections.
moduleScaleVariation: Large hero console, narrow proof strip, medium capability cards, row-based payment modules, pricing stage, and compact footer map.
breakoutBehavior: Dashboard placeholder and glowing final CTA escape the standard card rhythm to mark product evidence and conversion closure.
layoutRhythm: Dense command center opening, proof compression, explanatory workflow, product visibility pause, sales/compliance cadence, then pricing and FAQ closure.
cardCadence: Finance cards alternate between metric tiles, capability cards, workflow steps, table rows, pricing columns, and small footer map cells.
componentPatterns: navigation, header, primary button, secondary button, CTA pill, metric card, console card, pricing card, testimonial card, FAQ row, footer link card, image placeholder
ctaPlacement: Primary CTA appears in hero, pricing, security proof, and final demo band, with secondary model/demo cues for enterprise buyers.
imageTreatment: Product screenshots are editable console placeholders with explicit text clues, not generated imagery or copied reference artwork.
spacingCadence: Tight top hero density, generous section padding, compact row gaps for operations modules, and stronger pause before pricing and final CTA.
typographyBehavior: Space Grotesk display creates product authority; Inter body supports dense finance labels, stats, FAQ rows, and source notes.
colorRoles: Deep green-black base, carbon console surface, electric green action, cyan data accent, red risk status, pale text, muted ledger gray.
effectLanguage: Semantic data signal glow, action glow, console elevation, and pricing highlight effects attached to product evidence and conversion moments.
navigationPattern: Compact finance nav with product/security/pricing/resources and login/demo split.
footerPattern: Dense product-site footer map with reusable feature, use-case, pricing, security, resources, contact, and legal cells.
visualGrammarSummary: Enterprise finance command center with AI proof density, dashboard placeholders, compliance signal, and luminous risk/action accents.
marketplaceReadinessSummary: Twelve meaningful homepage blocks, editable text and image placeholders, pricing, FAQ, proof, CTA, footer map, and separate design-system board.
